# stb snapshot

Unmodified upstream files from [nothings/stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb),
commit `6b5799bae8a1fe3792691ef4b72ae26434c3e799`:

- `stb_image_write.h`: JPEG encoding, compiled by `image/stb_write.cpp`.
- `stb_image.h`: JPEG decoding in tests, compiled by `tests/support/stb_read.cpp`.

Both files include their MIT/public-domain licence alternatives at the end.
This project selects the MIT alternative and retains the notices verbatim.
See [ADR 0010](../../docs/adr/0010-jpeg.md) for scope and upgrade policy.
